name: Sino Oil and Gas Holdings Limited
summary: Sino Oil and Gas Holdings Limited is a Hong Kong-based holding company whose main business is producing coalbed methane in China, including its interest in the 383-square-kilometre Sanjiao block in the Erdos Basin. It also washes raw coal, sells raw and processed coal, develops and markets crude oil and natural gas, and offers financial services. Incorporated in 1999, it was previously called Genesis Energy Holdings Limited until a 2010 renaming.
